issue.title: Disposable SASE_HOME bead-store fixture so the pager bench can measure sase pager --plain bead:<id>

task_type_fields.proposal: Proposed by sase-1es.1 (note #1) and sase-1es.8 (note #8). The pager benchmark (tests/perf/bench_pager.py, `just bench-pager`) has a `sase pager --plain bead:<id>` cold-path probe, but it is always SKIPPED: no disposable SASE_HOME bead-store fixture exists to point it at. As a result the plan's inventory-memo target (`sase pager --plain bead:<id>` at or under 2.6s, was 4.5s) was never measured before or after epic sase-1es. Proposal: add a small, deterministic, disposable bead-store fixture builder (temp SASE_HOME with a few beads, notes, and links, built through `sase bead` APIs rather than hand-built sdd paths). Wire it into the bench's plain-bead probe so the cold bead path is measured, then record a number.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1es is closing. Building a reusable bead-store fixture is test-infrastructure work beyond its benchmark phase, which by design skipped the probe with a clear message when no fixture existed.

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1es pager bench skips its plain-bead cold-path probe everywhere for lack of a fixture, so the epic's bead-pager wall-time target was never measured.
